_schema.description: How-to-vote cards registered with the VEC for the 2026 election. scripts/refresh.py checks the VEC's register daily and records each card; the preference order on each card is entered by hand from the card PDF and is never overwritten.

fields.status: not_open (before registration opens) | open (register live, cards listed) | open_no_cards
fields.last_checked: ISO UTC time of the last successful check
fields.cards: [{house: lower|upper, district or region (id), registered_by (as listed by the VEC), party (code or null), candidate (independents: name as listed), registration (VEC number), registered_on (YYYY-MM-DD), card_url, order (party codes or candidate names in the card's preference order, first to last; null until entered), notes}]
